note: Ordering in this file is alphabetical-by-nothing: it is the fixed run order used by scripts/run-detectors.ts and carries no ranking meaning. Rankings live in data/cycles/<cycle>/leaderboard.json.
thresholdPolicy: Every detector is scored at the decision threshold its own vendor documents for an 'AI' verdict. Where a vendor publishes a band instead of a number, the low edge of the 'likely AI' band is used. Thresholds are frozen for the whole cycle and recorded here so a re-run cannot silently move a goalpost.

detectors.name: Winston AI
detectors.notes: Vendor score is a human-likeness score: 100 = fully human. The adapter inverts it to an AI probability before scoring so every detector is compared on one axis.

detectors.name: Originality.ai
detectors.notes: Model version is pinned per cycle. Turbo and Lite are scored as one entry using the model the vendor markets as default at cycle open. Reports ai_confidence on a 0-100 scale in the 2026-08 run logs, not 0-1.

detectors.name: GPTZero
detectors.notes: Reports a three-class distribution (human / ai / mixed). The AI class probability is used; the mixed mass is reported separately in the hybrid analysis.

detectors.name: Copyleaks AI Detector
detectors.notes: Requires a login exchange for a short-lived bearer token; the adapter caches it for the run. Reports ai_percent on a 0-100 scale in the 2026-08 run logs; the earlier 0-1 assumption in this file was wrong and would have clamped every reading to 100.

detectors.name: Sapling AI Detector
detectors.notes: Cheapest per-character API in the field, which makes it the usual choice for bulk pre-screening.

detectors.name: Undetectable.ai Detector
detectors.notes: Aggregates several third-party detectors behind one call. Included because it is widely used as a pre-publication gate, but its verdict is a committee vote, not an independent model.

detectors.name: ZeroGPT
detectors.notes: The most widely used free detector, and therefore the one whose false positives do the most real-world damage.

detectors.name: Isgen
detectors.notes: Markets multilingual detection; only the English corpus is scored in this cycle.

detectors.name: QuillBot AI Detector
detectors.notes: No public API. Collected through the manual path: two operators paste each sample into the web UI independently and both readings are recorded; disagreements above 10 points are re-read a third time.

detectors.name: Scribbr AI Detector
detectors.notes: No public API; manual path as above. Shares vendor ownership with QuillBot but is scored separately because the products expose different models and thresholds.

detectors.name: BrandWell AI Detector
detectors.notes: No public API; manual path as above.

detectors.name: Pangram
detectors.notes: Excluded at the maintainer's request when this benchmark was scoped, then included after the maintainer supplied a full 2026-08 run log for it. Both facts are recorded here rather than only the second.

excluded.name: Turnitin AI Writing Detection
excluded.reason: Sold only to institutions and unavailable for independent purchase. A benchmark nobody outside a licensed institution can reproduce is not a benchmark, so it is excluded rather than estimated.

excluded.name: Grammarly AI detection
excluded.reason: Ships as an authorship-provenance signal bundled into the editor rather than a standalone detector with a comparable AI-probability output. Revisit if a scored API is published.
